purpose: Teach: プライス/デイリー/タイムリー/コントラスト/不合格/日本経済新聞/レジスト/博覧

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、押収品のプライスタグを鑑識されますね
lines.en: The police forensically examine price tags on seized goods, don't they?
lines.style: Warm, appreciative tone. Steady rhythm, like ticking off items on a list. Slight lift of admiration on each point. Not obsequious—genuinely impressed by the thoroughness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、デイリーで犯罪発生件数を集計されますね
lines.en: The police compile crime statistics on a daily basis, I imagine?
lines.style: Continuing the rhythm, same warm admiration. Smooth connection between statements. Conversational, not interrogative despite the question form.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、タイムリーな市民通報を活かされますね
lines.en: And you make full use of citizens' timely tips, don't you?
lines.style: Still maintaining the appreciative cadence. Slight emphasize on 'timely'—recognizing the effort it takes. The warmth doesn't waver.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯映像のコントラスト解析もされますね
lines.en: You also analyze security footage for contrast and clarity, I see?
lines.style: The tone remains consistent and warm. Nodding rhythm. Each statement builds naturally on the last without rushing. Genuine curiosity underneath the politeness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、警察学校の不合格者にも再挑戦機会を与えられますね
lines.en: And you give people who fail the academy entrance exam a chance to retake it?
lines.style: Same appreciative warmth, but touching on something more human here. A beat of genuine respect. The rhythm stays steady but lands a little deeper.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、日本経済新聞の経済犯罪記事も注視されますね
lines.en: You keep a close eye on economic crime reporting in the major papers, too?
lines.style: Continuing without pause. The admiration is building naturally. Not flattery—just systematic recognition of competence and care.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、デモ参加者のレジスト姿勢にも対応されますね
lines.en: And you're trained to handle the various postures of protesters as well?
lines.style: Slight shift here—acknowledging a harder, more nuanced aspect of the work. Warmth stays but it becomes more respectful, less effusive. A nod to difficulty.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、博覧会の警備もご担当ですね
lines.en: So you handle security for major exhibitions and events like that?
lines.style: Closing statement. The tone softens slightly, becomes more natural and conversational. Less of the enumeration rhythm. A gentle landing—moving toward genuine dialogue rather than list-making.
